001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import java.util.Objects;
004import java.util.UUID;
005
006/**
007 * One entry on a ZonePractice Pro leaderboard. Immutable.
008 *
009 * @param playerId The player's unique id, never null
010 * @param playerName The player's last known name, never null
011 * @param rank The 1-based rank on the board
012 * @param score The value the board is sorted by
013 * @since 2.9.0
014 */
015public record LeaderboardEntry(UUID playerId, String playerName, int rank, int score) {
016
017    public LeaderboardEntry {
018        Objects.requireNonNull(playerId, "playerId");
019        Objects.requireNonNull(playerName, "playerName");
020        if (rank < 1) {
021            throw new IllegalArgumentException("rank must be at least 1");
022        }
023    }
024
025}
